Simon — thanks for the questions. Quick technical reply and attached materials.

Recommended model candidates (initial shortlist):
- rwx-multi-3B-instruct (quantized): strong tokens/per-cost balance; good morphological handling after locale-specific prompts.
- open-instruct-7B-multilang: higher quality on free-text answers; more cost but lower hallucination rate in our evals.
- msl-4B-sparse-finetuned (fast-path): best p95 latency on EU C3-class GPUs with batching.

Why these: we picked one lower-cost quantized path, one higher-capacity instruct model for quality-sensitive responses, and one optimized for latency. In our internal multi-locale tests these cover the common trade-offs you mentioned.

Benchmarks & thresholds (200–500 samples/locale recommended):
- Intent accuracy target: >= 92%
- Entity extraction (slot F1): >= 88%
- Dialogue-level hallucination rate: < 3% (manual spot checks + automated divergence heuristics)
- p95 latency target (hosted EU, single-turn, no chaining): 300–450ms depending on model/config.

Prompt/benchmark materials attached and linked:
- prompt pack: nordichealth_prompt_sets_v1.csv (includes intent labels, slot schema, example phrasings in da/sv/nb/en)
- benchmark report (summary): eu-apac-benchmarks-2027.pdf (short notebook results across similar healthcare workloads)
- evaluation notebook & dataset (Drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBz-example-benchmarks

Quality/regression concerns to watch for (locale-specific):
- Diacritic normalization: some open-tokenizers drop or normalize accented characters; include normalization step in preproc.
- Rare entity names: vendor/clinic names in Nordic languages have varied compounding; add synthetic augmentation.
- Date/time parsing: Norwegian numeric date formats can be ambiguous in free text (dd.mm vs mm/dd) — add guided slot prompts.

Suggested pilot plan (2 weeks):
Week 1: baseline eval across 3 models on 500-sample split per locale + basic latency profiling.
Week 2: prompt tuning on top model(s), run regression checks, produce final recommendations and cost/latency SLOs.

Attachments: nordichealth_prompt_sets_v1.csv, eu-apac-benchmarks-2027.pdf

If that looks good we’ll prepare the MA Plan and a proposed pilot cost sheet.

— Neha Kapoor
